text_block_list.text:
Having finished her debut race, King Halo 
is completely exhausted and out of breath, 
yet rejoices in the fact that she can now 
make her mark as a professional.

However, a phone call comes from King 
Halo's mother expressing disapproval of 
her debut. It was a sign of the deep rift 
between the two...

Determined to prove her clueless mother 
wrong, King Halo sets her next sights on a 
G1 race—the Hopeful Stakes.
